messages:
jamie: heads up — multiple customers reporting console charts hang during initial load after yesterday's deploy. happens on dashboard and per-route heatmaps.
ada: saw this in canary 10:15pm, thought it was network but reproduces locally with prod build.
martha: any new runtime flags or bundle changes in the deploy?
kevin: i only changed telemetry sampling config to 100% for a short window — we were missing traces. rolling back now but throwing this into thread.
ada: for context, when it freezes, chrome shows heavy main-thread time and a huge chunk loaded: ~1.2MB more in the chunks network tab.
sylvia: that sounds like a chunking/regeneration issue from our telemetry client. did the build accidentally inline the sampling map?
kevin: i modified packages/telemetry/src/index.ts to force capture for all events. snippet: ```ts
export const SAMPLER_RATE = 1.0; // temporarily set to capture everything
// was 0.01 before
```
jamie: @kevin can you revert to 0.01 quickly? we need a hotfix if it's making bundles tree-shake poorly.
kevin: revert PR open — rolling back the sampler change and kicking a canary: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/5219
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for sha abcdef (kevin/revert-sampler)
martha: looking at sourcemap - a new dependency ended up in the client build: telemetry-utils v2 pulled in a big locale map. possible accidental import of full map.
ada: repro steps I used: prod build + local server, open dashboard with ~6 charts. CPU spikes then chart workers spin and fail to render. console logs: "Uncaught RangeError: Invalid array length" from plot-worker.js:45
kevin: oh no — telemetry-utils had a default export that was tree-shaken poorly when sampled at 100%. i pushed a fix to use dynamic import in the client so the heavy map stays out of main bundle. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/5221
sylvia: can we add a bundle-size gate on CI for packages/console? we keep getting surprises from incidental imports.
martha: agreed. also suggest a quick telemetry config change: sample-to-server=false for client builds so we don't capture full payloads in frontend by default.
jamie: action items: 1) kevin revert deploy (in flight) 2) martha add bundle-size CI gate (small PR) 3) ada run synthetic load on canary to validate charts 4) sylvia follow up on telemetry client dynamic import.
ada: i'll validate canary in 10m and post results. will attach flamegraph if still bad.
kevin: reverting and hotfix merged, canary redeployed. keep an eye. sorry team — my bad for flipping the sampler globally. :grimacing:
ada: canary looks good so far, charts render and CPU back to normal. attaching quick flame snippet: ```
Main: 85% render / 5% telemetry parse / 10% idle
```
jamie: thanks everyone. let's keep the followups minimal and get the CI gate in this sprint. also document the telemetry sampling runbook so this doesn't happen again.
sylvia: noted — will add to eng-playbooks.
deploy-bot: canary deploy successful for sha abcdef (kevin/revert-sampler)
kevin: again, sorry folks. lesson learned: small config flips can leak into bundle if not careful.
martha: closing loop — filed issues: https://github.com/redwood/console/issues/1442 (bundle gate) and /1443 (telemetry runbook).
jamie: OK closing thread — reopen if you see regressions. :thumbsup:
